_comment_decoders: DTMF/ZVEI/CCIR are low-false-positive tone detectors - they surface selcall/paging bursts on VHF business channels that are not POCSAG/FLEX.
_comment_channels: Camped on 153.350. The raw-signal monitor shows EVERY transmission on this channel (live level trace + carrier events) even when nothing decodes. Other entries are selectable from the web UI dropdown. Note: rtl_power shows 150-165 MHz flat within ~3 dB here - if 153 stays idle, the traffic is UHF (461.4738 had a live POCSAG512 carrier 30 dB over noise).
